Perception Forest has special combat rules: Players' own development attributes and items will not take effect inside the match. 
You need to pick up weapons, Inner Ways, Mystic Skills, medicines, and other items inside the match to strengthen yourselves. There are four qualities of various items: white, blue, purple, and gold. The higher the quality, the stronger the effect. 
As the match progresses, the area where players can move will shrink, and the miasma outside the area will spread. Players who enter the miasma will continuously lose HP. To defeat other players, you'll need to equip high quality gear, coordinate your skills, and choose reasonable movement paths based on the style of battle. 
At the same time, the items in the bag will be converted into Sin Leaves according to their quality and quantity at the end of the match, which can be exchanged for rare rewards in the shop.
